outline: 本課程主要為探討能源轉換系統的基礎科目，將講授能量與動力原理，燃料與燃燒簡介、渦輪機與內燃機以及發電動力廠等原理，進而訓練學生具備分析動力系統之能力。
schedule:
週數	Date	Chap. No.	Chapter name
2/26		開學
1	2/27	1	Review: Introduction and Basic Concepts
2,3	3/6, 3/13	2, 3, 4, 5	Review: Energy, Energy Transfer, and General Energy Analysis (The First Law of Thermodynamics); Properties of Pure Substances; Energy analysis of Closed Systems;  ; Mass and Energy Analysis of Control Volumes
4	3/20	6	The Second Law of Thermodynamics (Heat Engines; Reversible and Irreversible Processes; Carnot Cycle; Carnot Heat Engine)
5	3/27	7	Entropy (Entropy; Isentropic Processes; Entropy change of Liquids, Solids and Ideal Gases)
6	4/3	8	Exergy: A Measure of Work Potential (Exergy Change of a System; Exergy Transfer by Heat, Work, and Mass; Exergy Balance)
7, 8	4/10, 17	9	Gas Power Cycles (Otto Cycle, Diesel Cycle)
9	4/24 期中考		Midterm Exam
10, 11	5/1, 5/8	9	Gas Power Cycles [Stirling and Ericsson Cycles; Brayton Cycles (The Ideal Cycle for Gas-Turbine Engine)]
12, 13, 14, 15	5/15, 5/22, 5/29, 6/5	10	Vapor and Combined Power Cycles (The Carnot Vapor Cycle; Energy Analysis of the Ideal Rankine Cycle, Actual Vapor Power Cycles, The Ideal Reheat Rankine Cycle, The Ideal Regenerative Rankine Cycle)
16, 17	6/12, 6/19	11	Refrigeration Cycles
18	6/26 期末考		Final Exam
assessment:
課本每章本文之例題以及文後之習題中有附答案部分，有助教演習課，優先列入期中考與期末考範圍
評分：
小考 20 分 (Optional)
期中考 40分
期末考 40分
